Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and headache consistent
with cervical strain. Over the course of care the patient attended 20 visits, cmobining manual therapy, range-of-motion exercises,
and home stretching program. Treatment followed a typical course, with frequency reduced as symptoms gradually improved and
the patient was discharged to self-directed exercise. Examination findings included reduced cervical range of motion and
paraspinal muscle tenderness, which support a soft tissue injury, while neurological screening and strength testing remained
within normal limits. The patient reports a remote, minor strain involving the same region that resolved completely without
lasting limitation. At this time, it is not yet clear to what extent the present symptoms are attributable to this collision versus the
prior strain, and further assessment may help clarify causation. Billing records reflect single entries for each service without
duplicate or repeated charges.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- objective_support: Do objective tests (imaging, exam findings) support the complaints? Allowed: Strong, Partial, Predominantly subjective, Contradicted.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- duplicate_billing: Was the same service, visit or part billed twice? Allowed: None, Possible, Confirmed.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
